name: @neuropause/deploy
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Production Execution Program, Sprint 1: Enterprise Production Foundation. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14 (unchanged) into a production deployment foundation: a real, versioned catalog of deployment assets (multi-stage Dockerfiles, docker-compose, Kubernetes manifests, a Helm chart, Infrastructure-as-Code templates, GitHub Actions workflows, environment configuration, monitoring stack config, backup/secrets/network configuration, and operator documentation) plus an evidence-first TypeScript foundation that indexes, validates, and governs those assets while REUSING the Wave 7 cloud-ops, Wave 12 operations, Wave 13 commercial, Wave 14 production, and security platforms. Deployment descriptors/Docker/Helm/workflows/config/docs/monitoring config are LIVE-VERIFIED (real, validated files); external clouds/Kubernetes/Vault/object stores are ADAPTER-VERIFIED until configured; deployment/release/runtime metrics and customer deployments are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING (never fabricated); and real clusters, cloud resources, databases, monitoring, DNS, TLS, and load balancers are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING — represented via validated descriptors, never claimed as created. Every deployment action is audited on the one chain with a replay id.
